resources.string: Phonetic Bangla typing — type \"amar\" to get আমার.
1. Enable the keyboard in system settings.
2. Switch to it with the keyboard picker.
3. Tap the 🌐 globe key to switch English ⇄ Bangla.
4. Tap ⇧ once for one capital (T → ট); it releases after one key.

Note: Android will warn that this keyboard \"may collect what you type.\" That is the standard message Android shows for every keyboard (even Gboard) — it is about what keyboards can technically do. Amader Bangla Keyboard has no internet permission, so it cannot send anything anywhere; everything stays on your device.
The keyboard follows your system light/dark theme.
Join consonants only when they form a real juktakkhor (so \"zkhn\" → যখন, but \"kSh\" → ক্ষ).
